item.title: Friday Morning, Oct 30
item.description:
The Friday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 30, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; Trump swaps weekend rallies for telerallies, Peltola denies knowing about Alaska's spoiler candidate as subpoenas go out, and the Justice Department subpoenas California election workers despite a judge's warning; Israel's final count leaves no majority, a rare local truce lets aid into Oleshky as Russia strikes Kyiv, and Qatar's mediators return to Tehran; futures slide as Amazon and Intel disappoint; Reddit blames Google's A.I. search for lost traffic; OpenAI rewrites its rulebook for model behavior; the record six-billion-dollar Binance hack blamed on North Korea; your X feed; Halloween, Sherrill's Law patrols and Tuesday's election here in New Hampshire; and a veteran's rebuilt car. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 4 PM Update, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: New York City conditions through tomorrow afternoon; Trump rallies for Darline Graham in South Carolina, the Boulder firebomber pleads guilty to federal hate crimes, and three news outlets accuse the White House of defying a court order; Israel asks the Shin Bet to probe foreign-interference claims, an EU peacekeeping helicopter crashes in Bosnia, Iran claims it captured a U.S. drone, and Ukraine says it hit Russian jets in Volgograd; the closing bell as Alphabet posts its worst day on record and Amazon misses slightly; DoorDash's seventeen-billion-dollar Instacart deal; Mistral opens up its trillion-parameter model; the Pentagon probes freezer failures as a possible hack, and hijacking Chrome extensions; your X feed, including the death of Sir Patrick Stewart; New York's bus fare enforcement pause, the Bronx e-bike fire, and Marathon Sunday closures; and a school named for a beloved custodian. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 1 PM Update, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: New York City conditions through tomorrow afternoon; GM's two-hundred-twenty-million-dollar driver-data settlement and the death of labor leader Dolores Huerta; Israel's count wraps up with no majority, Iran claims tankers hit mines near Hormuz, a container ship sinks after a drone attack off Bulgaria, and Yemen's hospitals buckle in Taiz; midday markets as Alphabet heads for its worst day on record while small caps rally; Alexa for Shopping takes over grocery lists; Anthropic's new Claude Enterprise tracking tools; a Linux flaw chained with the PHP2Shell attacks; your X feed; Sunset Park's Third Avenue redesign and record early voting; and the tallest mural in America. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: New York City conditions through tomorrow morning; Alaska's governor orders a probe of the spoiler-candidate allegations, and AP reports the U.S. warned allies to prepare for possible Iran strikes after the midterms; Israel's count of soldiers' and diplomats' ballots, the Dnipro toll rises, and Philippine-China friction at ASEAN defense talks; markets at the open after hotter inflation and stronger growth, Alphabet's plunge and the ECB on hold; Reddit's new For You feed and Nvidia's open transcription model; Google's Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defenders; a leak of DHS staff records and suspected hacking of base freezers; your X feed; a deadly Brooklyn crash as the city starts its Dusk and Darkness safety push; and a stranger's lunch gift in South Korea. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
